categories.name: wallet
categories.evidence: Touches descriptor sanity checking in `src/script/descriptor.cpp`, directly affecting wallet descriptor management and wallet loading behavior.
categories.rationale: Prevents creating vulnerable Tapscript Miniscript descriptors whose branches could be malleated by third parties without private keys. Because Tapscript serializes keys as x-only, duplicate keys differing only in parity prefix previously bypassed `DuplicateKeyCheck()` and violated BIP-379 non-malleability invariants.
